description: This PHP class defines a service for managing database backups and savepoints within a human resource management system. It facilitates creating, restoring, and deleting savepoints in a database, utilizing Doctrine DBAL and Symfony cache components. The class includes methods for generating cache keys, handling schema management, and executing database operations for savepoint management.

classes.name: DatabaseBackupService
classes.description: A service class responsible for managing database savepoints, including creation, restoration, and deletion, with caching and schema management support.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Retrieves the Doctrine DBAL Connection object from the entity manager.

methods.name: getSchemaManager
methods.description: Obtains schema management interface for database structure operations.

methods.name: getCache
methods.description: Fetches the cache adapter instance for functional testing.

methods.name: genSavepointCacheKeyPrefix
methods.description: Generates a cache key prefix for a given savepoint name.

methods.name: genSavepointCacheKey
methods.description: Generates a cache key for a specific table within a savepoint.

methods.name: createSavepoint
methods.description: Creates a savepoint with a specified name by capturing current table data.

methods.name: createInitialSavepoint
methods.description: Creates an initial savepoint and clears all existing savepoints.

methods.name: _createSavepoint
methods.description: Internal method that captures data from all tables and caches it under a specific prefix.

methods.name: restoreToSavepoint
methods.description: Restores database to a specified savepoint by re-inserting cached data.

methods.name: restoreToInitialSavepoint
methods.description: Restores database to the initial savepoint and clears cache.

methods.name: _restoreToSavepoint
methods.description: Internal method that restores data from cache into database tables.

methods.name: deleteSavepoint
methods.description: Deletes a specific savepoint by name.

methods.name: deleteSavepoints
methods.description: Deletes multiple savepoints or all savepoints if no names are provided.

methods.name: _deleteSavepoint
methods.description: Internal method for clearing cache entries related to a savepoint.

methods.name: deleteAllSavepoints
methods.description: Clears all stored savepoints and the initial savepoint.
